name: Ingoku Seijo Gakuen
source:
Main character is a physician who is invited to head school's health department. He is unwilling to take the job, but when he sees that it's a missionary school for girls, a wide smile covers his face.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/06/vn-of-month-august-2003-natsuyume-yawa.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名受邀担任学校保健部门负责人的医生。他本来不太情愿，可一看到那是所女子传教学校，脸上便露出了灿烂笑容。
